Hello from Selling Partner Support

We understand that you want to merge ASIN B08DKJ2K3T into ASIN B08CVLH794 to integrate the duplicate product detail page of the 4A PSS 32x6 note roll, and keep B08CVLH794 as target ASIN. 

After verification, ASIN B08DKJ2K3T is currently quoted by multiple channels in Amazon retail catalog and has active retail links. Due to the existence of these associations, the system was unable to perform the 

merge operation using this ASIN as the source. This is a platform-level limitation that applies to all UsedFor seller and is intended to ensure the integrity of retail catalog and the proper operation of existing orders and 

inventory. 

We understand that you explicitly want to keep B08CVLH794 as target ASIN and will not accept a reverse merge. Under current conditions, since source ASIN's retail-related restrictions cannot be circumvented, and the 

reverse merger is not within your scope of acceptance, this merge request cannot be executed for the time being. 

Your existing inventory and orders on both ASIN are unaffected: FBA inventory and pending orders on ASIN B08DKJ2K3T will continue to be fulfilled as normal, and FBM inventory on ASIN B08CVLH794 will also 

remain normal active. 

If your business requirements change in the future, or if you are willing to consider other merger options, please feel free to contact us and we will re-evaluate the feasibility for you. 

Reminder

Thank you for your trust and cooperation! As described above, your questions in this case have been addressed in accordance with the standard process. Reopening this case will generally not change the outcome of 

the case, provided that the facts and circumstances of the matter have not changed. 

If you have new questions or need additional help, we recommend that you click the link below to create a new case. The system will automatically assign you to the corresponding professional team to provide you 

with a faster and more accurate service. 

https://sellercentral.amazon.com/help/center?redirectSource=HelpHub
